system.description:
Suggestion, Mass

Enchantment (Compulsion) [Language-Dependent, Mind-Affecting]
Level:
Bard 5, Sorcerer/Wizard 6
Range:
Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets:
One creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions like suggestion, except that it can affect more creatures. The same suggestion applies to all these creatures.
system.materialComponent: A snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil.
